subject: Stabilization & Role-fit review: commitments, evidence, next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stabilization & Role-fit review: commitments, evidence, next steps

Hi Dylan —

Following our 1:1 this morning I wanted to capture the high-level plan we discussed so there’s a single place we can reference. I’m cc'ing Laura (People Ops) and Vivek so everyone has visibility. This is NOT a PIP — the goal is to set clear expectations and give structured support so you can stabilize in the role.

Summary of concerns (brief):
- repeated missed delivery on Feature X (estimates and final quality) across last two milestones
- inconsistent responsiveness to design questions causing rework for other squads
- evidence of task prioritization drift (time-on-task higher than peers for similar scope)

What we agreed today: a 5-week focused stabilization window with measurable checkpoints.

Mutual Action Plan (attached: mutual-action-plan-2026-08-21.docx):
- Week 1 (by 2026-08-28): replicate the current Feature X scope in a pared-down branch; daily standups M/W/F with me, include a 3-line status and blockers.
- Week 2 (by 2026-09-04): complete code review loop within 24 hours of PR submission for critical PRs; pair with mentor (Vivek suggested pairing twice this week).
- Week 3 (by 2026-09-11): deliver a postmortem for the last missed milestone with concrete root causes and mitigation actions (attached evidence checklist to guide artifacts).
- Week 5 (by 2026-09-18): management decision point — either role stabilization confirmed or next formal step discussed (documented).

Success criteria (explicit):
- no critical regressions in Feature X deliveries during the window
- average time-to-first-response on code review comments <= 48 hours for priority PRs
- demonstrable adoption of suggested prioritization template for weekly planning

Support we will provide:
- weekly 1:1s focused on blockers and evidence review (I’ll book these)
- pairing time with Vivek (1.5 hrs/week) and optional mentor hours with Monica in Platform Eng (voluntary)
- People Ops coaching session (Laura to coordinate)

Please confirm receipt and add anything I missed. I’ve attached the role expectations v2 (clarified success criteria) and an evidence checklist to make it easier to surface artefacts.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Engineering Manager, Core Platform
Redwood Inference

Kim —

Thanks for the write-up and for laying out a clear path. I confirm receipt and agree to the plan and timelines. A couple quick notes:
- I’ll start the pared-down branch today and post the first status by EOD.
- For the pairing sessions, I prefer Tue/Thu mornings — Vivek, does that work for you?
- I’ll gather the requested artifacts for the postmortem and attach the initial log by 2026-08-27.

I appreciate the support and will be proactive in communicating blockers.

—Dylan

Thanks for looping me in, Kim. A few process notes from People Ops:
- I’ll schedule a 30-min coaching kickoff with Dylan this week (calendar invite sent) to align on expectations and to confirm any accommodations.
- Please keep a short, dated evidence trail (screenshot diffs, PR timestamps, pairing notes). The attached CSV template should be used to log artifacts — we’ll need that for any later formal steps.
- HR will not be making decisions this week; our role is to ensure fairness and that supports are in place. If at any point behavior escalates instead of improving, flag me immediately.

Kim: can you confirm you’ll keep weekly notes from your 1:1s (5–10 bullets) and share them after each session? That will be helpful for transparency.

Laura

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, external-peopleops-consultant@example.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Weekly checkpoint - week 3 evidence & next steps

Team —

Quick update after today’s checkpoint with Dylan. Attaching the filled evidence checklist and a short summary of the 1:1 (see attachments). Highlights:
- Dylan delivered the pared-down Feature X branch and completed two pairing sessions with Vivek. PR review turn time improved to ~36 hours for priority PRs.
- Postmortem draft received; root causes called out: underestimating inter-service deps and insufficient upfront design tests. Dylan proposed concrete mitigations (risk buffer for estimates, a short design validation checklist).
- Still seeing one recurring area: task scoping for cross-team stories — Dylan agreed to route all cross-team tickets to me for quick clarity checks for the remainder of the window.

Next steps:
- Continue weekly 1:1s; I’ll share the 1:1 bullets each Friday.
- Vivek will continue two short pairing slots/week through Week 5.
- Laura to run the coaching session and confirm receipt of evidence artifacts.
- We will reconvene at the Week 5 decision point (2026-09-18) to discuss stabilization outcome.

If anyone sees factual errors in the attached evidence log, reply-all with corrections.

Thanks,
Kim

--
